claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: SKF-86002 is a p38 MAPK/ALOX5 inhibitor that is unlikely to kill cells at 2.5 uM; p38 inhibition is cytostatic/anti-inflammatory rather than cytotoxic, and no cytotoxic off-target is evident.
